ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Adani Energy Solutions Limited will engage with investors and analysts at two major conferences, Emkay Confluence and Motilal Oswal Global Investor Conference, in Mumbai during August 2026. These scheduled one-on-one and group meetings are routine investor relations activities, signaling proactive transparency with the financial community regarding company performance and strategy. The filing is a standard regulatory disclosure and presents no immediate red flags or unusual material impacts beyond fostering ongoing investor engagement.
